name: Dressler & Kang Bespoke Dress Oxford — Last-Form
description: A cap-toe oxford built on a custom last — your last, filed and kept at the Dressler & Kang atelier on Level 49. The upper is hand-lasted in full-grain synthetic cordovan in deep oxblood, with a Goodyear welt that can be resoled indefinitely. The insole contains a passive biometric reader that confirms the wearer's identity and can trigger a building-access profile with each step.
functionality: Passive biometric insole for access authentication, resole-capable Goodyear welt, custom last fitting.
what_it_says: You have shoes built for your feet specifically, and you will be buried in them.
story_hooks: The biometric insole data is stored locally — but the atelier holds a backup on file, and whoever controls that archive controls a map of where every client has walked.
A pair was commissioned for an executive who died before pickup; the last still exists, the shoes were never claimed, and they fit only one person.
